intro: Industrial and energy sectors bore the brunt of OT-security threats between April and June 2026, with a global impact spanning North America, Europe, and the Middle East. APT33 and Pro-Russia Hacktivists were observed among the threat actors, while CVE-2026-24032 (CVSS 7.3) was a significant vulnerability. The coverage of 10 articles included three high-severity and one critical-severity incident, alongside four informational and one medium-severity report, affecting critical infrastructure, manufacturing, and industrial environments.
